title: $H^2(\Omega)$ A Priori Error Bounds for Boundary-Adapted PINNs Solving Elliptic Dirichlet Problems
abstract: arXiv:2607.19167v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the numerical resolution of uniformly elliptic Dirichlet boundary value problems (BVPs) by minimization of the PDE residual over a hypothesis space of Neural Networks made to satisfy exactly the boundary conditions through multiplication by a user-defined \emph{distance-to-boundary approximation} $\rho$. While an $L^2(\partial\Omega)$ boundary penalty cannot generally guarantee $H^2(\Omega)$ error control, we show that exact enforcement can, provided $\rho$ is chosen appropriately. More precisely, we identify a sharp sufficient condition on $\rho$ preserving the regularity needed for $H^2(\Omega)$ error control, provide practical constructions of such $\rho$ for general smooth domains $\Omega$, and refer to the resulting networks as \emph{boundary-adapted}. For boundary-adapted Rectified Quadratic Unit (ReQU) and hyperbolic tangent (tanh) networks, we then derive explicit high-probability $H^2(\Omega)$ convergence rate

translated_title: 求解椭圆狄利克雷问题的边界自适应物理信息神经网络的 $H^2(\Omega)$ 先验误差界
translated_abstract: 我们研究通过在神经网络假设空间中最小化偏微分方程残差来数值求解一致椭圆狄利克雷边值问题（BVPs），其中神经网络通过乘以用户定义的“到边界距离近似”函数 $\rho$ 来精确满足边界条件。虽然 $L^2(\partial\Omega)$ 边界惩罚通常无法保证 $H^2(\Omega)$ 误差控制，但我们证明了只要 $\rho$ 选择得当，精确施加边界条件可以实现这种控制。更确切地说，我们确定了 $\rho$ 上保持 $H^2(\Omega)$ 误差控制所需正则性的一个尖锐充分条件，为一般光滑区域 $\Omega$ 提供了此类 $\rho$ 的实用构造，并将由此得到的网络称为“边界自适应”网络。对于边界自适应的整流二次单元网络和双曲正切网络，我们推导出了显式的高概率 $H^2(\Omega)$ 收敛速率。
tldr: 本文通过乘以适当的到边界距离函数精确施加边界条件，构造了“边界自适应”神经网络，证明精确施加边界条件（而非 $L^2$ 边界惩罚）可以实现椭圆狄利克雷问题的 $H^2(\Omega)$ 误差控制，并推导出显式的高概率收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs "boundary-adapted" neural networks that exactly enforce boundary conditions through multiplication by an appropriately chosen distance-to-boundary function, proving that exact enforcement—unlike $L^2$ boundary penalties—can guarantee $H^2(\Omega)$ error control for elliptic Dirichlet problems, with explicit high-probability convergence rates.
